name: zonefall
description: Browser battle royale: Rust/WebAssembly simulation + raw WebGPU renderer + Cloudflare Durable Objects multiplayer

scripts.wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs
scripts.build: npm run wasm && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.server:dev: npm run wasm && npm run build && npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.server:deploy: npm run build && npm --prefix server run deploy
